onset.Description: The onset of the stimulus in seconds, with respect to the fMRI acquision start (first volume). n/a if rest trial.

duration.Description: The duration of the stimulus presentation in seconds

trial_type.Description: Indicates whether the trial includes a visual stimulus or not (rest)

stim_level.Description: The level of the stimulus, from 1 (lowest) to 4 (highest)

stim_value.Description: The contrast value. n/a if rest trial.
